summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 29, 2026. The meeting approved the election of eight directors and the ratification of Deloitte as independent auditors for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation elements. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no material event that would alter the company's structure or strategy. As a non-US filing, it serves as a foreign private issuer's equivalent of a domestic 8-K reporting annual meeting results.
